about: BO-15's correction detector cases. Each case is a short session (events, in Claude Code's real transcript shapes via tests/transcripts/mod.rs) and what the detector must find: `expect` maps a turn number (every prompt counts, task notifications too) to the exact signals of that turn as 'LAYER kind'; a turn not listed has none. `checks` lists the turns whose prompt carries the C4 line. Every text is made up. BO-17's backstop adds a case here for each correction the detector missed.
